disposition_reason: SEM/EDX morpho-chemical identification of inorganic particles (including Zn-, Pb- and Sb-bearing particles) on pollen loads from forager bees; no metal concentrations are reported.

study.design: Particle characterization on pollen loads dissected from hind legs of forager bees at an industrial site and a control site
study.origin: peri-urban Parma, Po Valley, Northern Italy, about 100 m from the A1 highway near an incinerator; negative control in a rural area 10 km south of Parma

period.as_reported: hive placed February 2017; pollen sampled May to August (Table 1 months; year of sampling not restated)

unresolved: Results are presence/absence of particle phases by month (Table 1) and micrographs; no concentrations in µg/kg can be extracted.
Only 40 pollen grains were analysed in total.
